lead_in: Name any FIVE of the 13 original states:
question_text: There were 13 original states. Name five.

why_it_matters.text: The 13 original states were the first members of the United States. Each was a separate colony that fought together in the Revolution and then agreed to form one country. The 13 stripes on the U.S. flag still honor them today.

fun_fact.text: Delaware was the first state to ratify the Constitution — December 7, 1787, by a unanimous 30-0 vote. That's why its nickname is 'The First State.' Rhode Island was DEAD LAST — May 29, 1790, almost 3 years later. Rhode Island only agreed after Congress threatened to treat it as a foreign country.
